script:
wscript

// Coded by Manzft

// Vars
acc = 60 //has to be the same or higher than min_speed or mario wont walk lol
air_acc = 30
skid = false
skid_acc = 10
skid_dir = ""
skid_tolerance = 0.8
crouch = false
speed = 400
run_speed = 700
min_speed = 60
jump_strength = 1000
started_jumping = false
jumping = false
jump_running = false
jump_timer = 0.0
jump_max_time = 17
jump_run_max_time = 21

// Start func
start()
    GetComponent("Sprite").Play("idle")
end

// Movement system
movementSystem()
    spd = GetComponent("").speed_x
    max_speed = speed
    if (CheckInput("run"))
        max_speed = run_speed
    end
    
    _acc = acc
    if (skid)
        _acc = skid_acc
    end
    if (!IsOnFloor())
        _acc = air_acc
    end
    if (CheckInput("right") and spd < max_speed)
        if (!crouch)
            AddSpeedX(_acc)
        end
        if (IsOnFloor())
            GetComponent("Sprite").SetFlipX(false)
        end
    elif (CheckInput("left") and spd > max_speed*-1)
        if (!crouch)
            AddSpeedX(_acc*-1)
        end
        if (IsOnFloor())
            GetComponent("Sprite").SetFlipX(true)
        end
    end
end

// Skid system
skidSystem()
    spd = GetComponent("").speed_x
    
    skid_speed = run_speed
    skid_speed *= skid_tolerance
    if (IsOnFloor())
        if (CheckInput("right") and spd <= skid_speed*-1 and !skid)
            skid = true
            skid_dir = "right"
        elif (CheckInput("left") and spd >= skid_speed and !skid)
            skid = true
            skid_dir = "left"
        else
            if (skid_dir == "right" and CheckInput("left"))
                skid = false
            elif (skid_dir == "left" and CheckInput("right"))
                skid = false
            end
            if (skid_dir == "right" and spd > 0)
                skid = false
            elif (skid_dir == "left" and spd < 0)
                skid = false
            end
        end
    else
        skid = false
    end
end

// Crouch system
crouchSystem()
    // Crouch activation
    if (IsOnFloor())
        if (CheckInput("crouch"))
            crouch = true
            skid = false
        else
            crouch = false
        end
    end
    
    // Crouch auto deactivation
    if (!IsOnFloor() and GetComponent("").speed_y > 0 and !CheckInput("crouch"))
        crouch = false
    end
end

// Animation system
animSystem()
    spd = GetComponent("").speed_x
    if (crouch)
        if (GetComponent("Sprite").GetAnimation() != "crouch")
            GetComponent("Sprite").Play("crouch")
        end
    elif (IsOnFloor())
        if (spd == 0 and !CheckInput("left") and !CheckInput("right"))
            if (GetComponent("Sprite").GetAnimation() != "idle")
                GetComponent("Sprite").Play("idle")
            end
        else
            if (skid)
                if (GetComponent("Sprite").GetAnimation() != "skid")
                    GetComponent("Sprite").Play("skid")
                end
            else
                if (GetComponent("Sprite").GetAnimation() != "walk")
                    GetComponent("Sprite").Play("walk")
                end
                
                _spd = spd
                if (_spd < 0)
                    _spd *= -1
                end
                speed_percent = speed/_spd
                GetComponent("Sprite").ChangeFPS("walk", 10/speed_percent)
            end
        end
    else
        if (started_jumping)
            if (GetComponent("Sprite").GetAnimation() != "jump")
                GetComponent("Sprite").Play("jump")
            end
        else
            GetComponent("Sprite").Stop()
        end
    end
end

// Min speed fix
minSpeed()
    spd = GetComponent("").speed_x
    if (spd < min_speed and spd > min_speed*-1 and IsOnFloor())
        GetComponent("").speed_x = 0
    end
end

// Jump system
jumpSystem()
    spd = GetComponent("").speed_x
    if (spd < 0)
        spd *= -1
    end

    if (CheckInput("jump") and IsOnFloor())
        GetComponent("").speed_y = jump_strength*-1
        started_jumping = true
        jumping = true
        jump_timer = 0
        GetComponent("Sound").Play()
        if (spd >= run_speed)
            jump_running = true
        end
    end
    
    if (jumping)
        if (!CheckInput("jump"))
            jump_timer = 0
            jumping = false
            jump_running = false
        end
    
        max_time = jump_max_time
        if (jump_running)
            max_time = jump_run_max_time
        end
        if (jump_timer < max_time)
            jump_timer += 1
            GetComponent("").speed_y = jump_strength*-1
        else
            jump_timer = 0
            jumping = false
            jump_running = false
        end
    end
    
    if (IsOnFloor() and GetComponent("").speed_y == 0)
        started_jumping = false
        jumping = false
        jump_running = false
    end
end

// Frame func
frame()
    crouchSystem()
    animSystem()
    movementSystem()
    skidSystem()
    minSpeed()
    jumpSystem()
end
